metadata.notes: Fiscal year ended April 30, 2012. Production and per-BOE metrics from item7 table. DD&A $575,990. Average prices realized: oil $77.49/Bbl, gas $3.59/Mcf, total $51.49/BOE. Production 54% oil, 46% gas. LOE includes ad valorem taxes. First year of oil and gas operations for the company.
